messages:
incident-bot: New follow-up required for outage RWINF-629. Please coordinate the post-incident review. Original incident started 2026-03-10 02:13 UTC. Link: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RWINF-629>

Alex: I'll start a thread for scheduling the review. Who can chair? Prefer someone neutral.

Priya: I can chair if nobody else wants. I'm OOO next Wed.

Miguel: I can take it too — timezone works for me. What dates are we thinking?

Sam: prefer mornings (PST). I'm flexible Tues/Thu.

Jin: CEST morning is fine; I can do Tue/Thu 09:00-11:00 CEST.

Taylor: Can we do 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC? That's Tue 09 PST / 17 CEST.

Priya: That works for me. Miguel?

Miguel: 16th is OK but prefer to avoid clash with release freeze — what's the duration? 45-60m?

Alex: plan 60m. Agenda: timeline, root cause, action items + owners, rollout checks.

Sam: I'll claim action item tracking during the meeting (note-taker).

Taylor: I can prepare timeline slides (5-10m). Will drop link later.

incident-bot: Created postmortem draft: <https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/RWINF-629-draft> by Alex

Priya: I'll chair then. @Sam please add the meeting to calendar.

Sam: Scheduling — suggest 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC, 60m. Calendar invite with Zoom created: /zoom --topic "RWINF-629 post-incident review" --start 2026-03-16T16:00Z --duration 60

Jin: Heads up, ETL team needs to attend for RCA. @Miguel can you ping them?

Miguel: Pinged ETL folks in #eng-data, @Marie and @Li. They said they'd join if scheduled.

Taylor: Can we add a remote-friendly agenda section for "customer impact & comms" so support/customer success can join for 15m?

Alex: Good call. Adding 15m slot. Updated agenda link: <https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/RWINF-629-draft#agenda>

Priya: Attendee list: Priya (chair), Alex, Miguel, Sam (notes), Jin, Taylor, Marie, Li, Jordan (CS). Anyone else?

Sam: I've added room: Zoom + transcription on. I'll attach notes doc and take meeting minutes.

incident-bot: Reminder: Please claim action items in thread with prefix "ACTION:" so the tracker picks them up.

Miguel: ACTION: I'll own "KV cache metrics instrumentation" — target: 2026-03-23.

Li: ACTION: I'll prepare customer impact numbers (rows affected / customers) — target: 2026-03-18.

Marie: I'll join and bring logs from ETL pipeline.

Taylor: ACTION: I'll add timeline slides to the doc by EOD tomorrow (2026-03-12).

Priya: If someone can't make 16th, we need a backfill. @Alex — can you chair if I bump into a conflict?

Alex: Yes I can backfill-chair if needed.

Sam: Invite sent to attendees + CS. Calendar shows tentative for Marie/Li. Zoom link in invite.

Jin: Quick note on handoff: if pager goes off in the meeting window, who handles live mitigation? I'd prefer on-call not be in the chair role.

Priya: Good point. Can we set a primary incident on-call for live mitigation: @oncall-night? And backup @oncall-day.

Alex: I'll add a one-line handoff in the invite: "If paged during the review, oncall handles mitigation; chairs continue if mitigation non-blocking."

Sam: Added handoff line and pinned to the invite notes.

Taylor: Also adding a pre-read section with key logs + the fast-replay timeline so folks can scan before the meeting.

incident-bot: Note: postmortem template includes 'severity', 'timeline', 'impact', 'root cause', 'actions'. Use ACTION: prefix to assign.

Priya: Final attendee confirmation: Priya, Alex, Miguel, Sam, Jin, Taylor, Marie, Li, Jordan (CS). All good?

Jordan: I'll be there for comms notes.

Sam: see you all Tue 16:00 UTC. :calendar:

Alex: :thumbsup:
